Name: Abijam, King of Judah
Summary: Abijam, son of Rehoboam, reigned three years in Jerusalem and walked in the sins of his father, though God preserved David's line in Jerusalem for David's sake.
KeyStory: Abijam's short reign and war with Jeroboam.
LifeLesson: A short reign still matters: God judges kings by whether their hearts are wholly His.
